Insert capabilities overview

Action to paste the structured “What Oasis can do in this build” Markdown (sections for web search, Q&A, summarize, tabs, groups, split view, memory/history, support links).

What this is

You can insert a structured capabilities overview into the chat: what Oasis can do in this build (web search, tabs, split view, memory, support links).

How to use it

  • Look for capabilities or what can you do affordance in the composer or header (wording varies).
  • Confirm if a dialog asks; the insert is plain Markdown you can edit before sending.
  • Read the Support and feedback section for Kahana feature list and Tally form.

Notes and limits

Capabilities reflect the tools compiled into your build; missing tools are called out in the overview text.
